title: Case 048: The buyer said payment was sent
initial_request: Please check whether the payment our buyer says they sent for our workshop invoice has reached our H&V business account.
overview: Mara Ellison escalated a missing incoming payment query for Alder Quay Studio Ltd. The buyer had messaged the company saying they had paid, but the credit had not been reconciled against the invoice. H&V checked the company account's incoming activity and could not identify a matching credit at the time of the check.

next_action.summary: Check the company's incoming account activity for an identifiable credit matching the payment details available to H&V.

outcome: H&V's check found no identifiable incoming credit at that time. This does not establish whether the buyer sent a payment or what its status is with the buyer's bank, and the invoice has not been confirmed as paid.

events.body: I've sent payment for the workshop invoice. Please let me know when it reaches you.

events.from: Mara Ellison, Alder Quay Studio Ltd.
events.body: I'm the authorised accountant for our business. Our buyer says they sent payment for the workshop invoice, but I can't reconcile it in our incoming activity. Please check whether an identifiable credit has reached our account.
I’m checking Alder Quay Studio Ltd.’s incoming account activity for an identifiable credit matching the payment details available to the bank.
No identifiable incoming credit matching the available payment details is shown in the account activity checked.

events.to: Mara Ellison, Alder Quay Studio Ltd.
events.body: We checked your business account's incoming activity and could not identify a matching credit at the time of the check. This check does not confirm the status of a payment in the buyer's bank, or confirm that your invoice has been paid.
